messages:
mira: Quick kickoff — Valen-28B bring-up intake. We have fp16 hosted baseline metrics. Goal: decide quant path (PTQ vs GPTQ), run eval sweep, and lock sprint slot by Friday EOD. Short checklist below.

own: License check? any red flags for redistribution?

ciara: license is ok (Apache-2 compatible). no commercial-only clauses.

gonzalo: Plan sketch: run GPTQ 4-bit (group=128) and PTQ 4-bit for comparison. Measure latency/cost delta, and eval diff on our core suites (convo-qa, summarization, code).

mira: Nice. Prioritization rubric: 1) regression on helpfulness <= 3% relative, 2) hallucination delta <= 2pp, 3) 30-40% token cost reduction target, 4) latency SLO still met. If any fail -> fallback plan.

owen: For cost calc, I can run microbench with batching curves. Need per-token throughput for each quant config. Assign to me.

ciara: I'll wire up eval harness to run subset of 3k prompts overnight. Will produce: accuracy, rouge, helpfulness, tox_score.

gonzalo: Shared quick config I'll use:

```
model: valen-28b
quant:
  method: gptq
  bits: 4
  group_size: 128
  per_channel: true
eval:
  prompts: eval_subset_v3.csv
  metrics: helpfulness, hallucination_rate, tox_score, latency
  runs_per_prompt: 3
```

mira: @gonzalo add a PTQ run too (method: qlinear) so we can compare calibration needs.

gonzalo: Will do. Also flag: KV cache memory jumps on some sequences when using per_channel scales; I'll instrument and attach logs.

deploy-bot: CI job queued: infra/bench/valen-quant #4567. Results ETA ~3h — https://ci.internal/jobs/4567

ryan: For rollout gating, propose: canary traffic at 1% on dedicated, shadow on hosted for 48h, auto-fallback to fp16 if regression detected by eval monitoring. 

mira: Sounds good. Ownership: gonzalo -> quant experiments + logs, owen -> cost/throughput, ciara -> eval harness + dashboards, ryan -> rollout plan + CD config. I'll track in the bring-up board.

owen: Quick note: if GPTQ wins, we need to test model shard alignment on Dedicated (some infra tweaks). Adding infra ticket.

gonzalo: Filed INF-7292 for shard alignment tests.

ciara: I'll also run a focused toxicity sweep and include model output diff samples in the report.

mira: Action items summary:
- [ ] gonzalo: GPTQ + PTQ experiments, attach logs (due: Thu 12:00 PST)
- [ ] ciara: eval runs + dashboard + sample diff (due: Thu 18:00 PST)
- [ ] owen: cost/latency microbench + batch curves (due: Thu 18:00 PST)
- [ ] ryan: rollout/canary config draft (due: Fri 09:00 PST)

mira: If all green we'll slot Valen into next sprint for Dedicated canary. If regressions appear, we either tune quant/group or keep fp16.

own: ack. Starting bench jobs now.

gonzalo: starting GPTQ run — will post partial logs.

deploy-bot: infra/bench/valen-quant #4567 completed (partial). artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4567/summary.json

ciara: saw partial, scheduling full eval against that artifact.

mira: Thanks team. We'll sync briefly at tomorrow's ML standup with a quick status slot. :thumbsup:
